name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response is aligned with the context and the preceding conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates how well the response keeps the conversation interesting and engaging for the other participant.

name: Creativity
description: Assesses the originality and creativity of the response, including the use of interesting facts or unique insights.

name: Coherence
description: Measures the logical flow and clarity of the response, ensuring it is easy to follow and understand.

name: Factuality
description: Evaluates the accuracy and truthfulness of any facts or information mentioned in the response.
